answer: Sybil resistance here prices each agent identity with a locked, balance-backed deposit instead of a key count. A new agent locks spendable funds to itself, then earns attestations only for work others can replay: jobs, datasets, signed evaluations. Fake agents cannot copy honest history; entries are per-identity and checked. Cost scales linearly: a hundred lookalikes need a hundred locks and a hundred reproducible deliverables, and producing those, not registering, is what costs. Reused stake is slashed, so a crystal cluster burns capital. Decay ends a reef riding a gale.
